rationale: Treats the panel as binary switches followed by a separate execution button. Reads switch positions and the lower reference pattern directly from each frame, first tries matching that pattern, then explores configurations while learning their actual movement. Tracks board states independently of the draining timer, penalizes ineffective executions and revisited states, and favors learned movement toward the smaller purple object. This directly addresses the previous policy's failure to execute configured switches.
